title: Backend Engineer with Python, PHP along with web scraping
text:
Company Description

Job Description
Software Engineer, Pune
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Mid Software Engineer based in Pune/Chennai. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of scalable backend architectures, web scraping pipelines, and core web applications. You will balance data extraction engineering with robust backend development using Python, PHP and PostgreSQL. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love solving complex data challenges, this role is for you. 
Responsibilities 
Data Extraction & Web Scraping 
Build scalable web crawlers to harvest structured and unstructured web data using custom and enterprise frameworks. 
Manage dynamic content extraction using advanced browser automation tools for JavaScript-heavy, AJAX, and infinite-scroll sites. 
Optimize crawling performance through concurrent execution, asynchronous programming, and container multi-threading. 
Backend & Application Engineering 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend microservices using Python and PHP. 
Build web applications and custom internal tools using the PHP CodeIgniter framework. 
Design Python based RESTful APIs to ensure seamless data integration across cross-functional platforms. 
Database Management & Operations 
Write efficient, optimized SQL queries and manage schema design within PostgreSQL. 
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex production issues to maintain system stability. 
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Product, QA, DevOps, and other engineering units.
Qualifications
Must Have Experience: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
Web Scraping: Deep proficiency with Python parsing packages (Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, LXML, Requests). 
Browser Automation: Hands-on experience handling browser execution via Selenium, Playwright, or Pyppeteer. 
PHP: Strong development experience in PHP and the CodeIgniter framework. 
Database: Solid understanding of PostgreSQL database schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. 
Architecture: Strong foundation in designing Microservices and building robust RESTful APIs. 
Soft Skills: Ownership: Ability to take a project from concept to delivery independently. 
Collaboration: Strong communication skills to align with remote and local cross-functional teams. 
Agility: A proactive mindset that thrives in fast-paced, continuous-improvement environments. 
Nice to Have Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines. 
Containerization: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes orchestration. 
Tooling: Experience with Git version control and logging, monitoring, and observability tools. 
Methodology: Familiarity working within Agile/Scrum frameworks using JIRA

title: ServiceNow Developer – ITAM, OTSM
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Roles & Responsibilities :

Job Description 
Develop and enhance ServiceNow solutions across IT Asset Management (ITAM) and Operational Technology Service Management (OTSM). The role requires strong ServiceNow development skills with hands-on specialization in ITAM and/or OTSM, including asset lifecycle management, OT service workflows, CMDB integration and enterprise automation. 
Key Responsibilities 
IT Asset Management (ITAM) 

HAM & SAM Development: Configure and enhance Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM), including asset lifecycle, stockrooms, software models, entitlements and normalization. 

Asset Lifecycle & Compliance: Automate asset lifecycle processes, software reconciliation, license compliance and asset governance workflows. 

Asset & CMDB Integration: Integrate procurement, endpoint, Discovery and external asset data with CMDB CIs while maintaining accurate asset-to-CI relationships. 

ITAM Automation & Integration: Develop workflows and integrations using Flow Designer/Workflow Studio, IntegrationHub, APIs and enterprise data sources. 
Operational Technology Service Management (OTSM) 

OT Service Workflows: Develop OT incident, change and operational workflows supporting industrial assets and production environments. 

OT Asset Visibility: Configure OT asset records, relationships and CMDB integration to improve visibility across industrial and operational technology environments. 

IT/OT Integration: Integrate approved OT inventory, monitoring and enterprise data sources using secure and non-disruptive integration patterns. 

OT Governance & Automation: Implement workflow automation, approvals, auditability and controls aligned with industrial security and operational requirements. 
Experience & Qualifications 

Experience: 7–12 years overall in software/platform engineering, with strong practical ServiceNow development experience. 

Primary Specialization: Demonstrated hands-on experience in ITAM and/or OTSM, including asset lifecycle, OT workflows or integration with enterprise systems. 

ServiceNow Development: Strong JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs, Flow Designer/Workflow Studio and upgrade-safe platform development. 

Integrations: Strong experience with REST/JSON APIs, IntegrationHub, import sets/transform maps and enterprise integration patterns. 

Asset & CMDB Fundamentals: Strong understanding of asset-CI relationships, lifecycle management, CMDB integration, data quality and governance. 

Engineering Delivery: Experience with requirements analysis, technical design, testing/ATF, debugging, peer review, releases and L2/L3 production support. 
Additional / Preferred Experience 

AI & Intelligent Operations: Exposure to Now Assist, GenAI, AI Agents/agentic workflows, AIOps and AI governance for ITOM/CMDB use cases. 

Automation & Observability: Experience with IntegrationHub, Workflow Studio, REST APIs, Service Graph Connectors, cloud and monitoring/observability tools. 

Engineering & Cross-Domain: Familiarity with ATF, Git/CI-CD, Python/PowerShell and integration of ITSM, ITAM or OTSM with ITOM and CMDB. 
Certifications 

Mandatory: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) - Data Foundations (CMDB & CSDM) 

Desirable: Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (e.g., CIS-HAM and/or CIS-SAM certification) and ServiceNow OTSM product-specific training

title: Escalation Engineer - ZTB
text:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role

We are looking for an Escalation Engineer to join our team in a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Customer Support. The Escalation Engineer will provide world-class post-sales technical support to internal Level I & Level II Support Engineers, as well as provide direct support to customers and partners on escalated issues, as part of an escalation team. The Escalation Engineer will also work directly with Operations and Engineering on opening bugs and requests with all required diagnostic information.  

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

Engage with customers on escalated support issues or critical customer situations and participate in a 24x7 Support Operation and 24x7 on-call rotation

Interface with Engineering and assist the customer with testing or troubleshooting

Reproduce customer issues to verify problems and provide feedback to Engineering and Operations teams

Create entries in our technical support online database to accurately document any incident resolution that is not found in our knowledge base

Understand the product direction and customer use-cases and provide input on product and code changes through all points of the product cycle

Who You Are (Success Profile)

You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.

You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

Practical knowledge of networking and security products and enterprise network infrastructure
